edits.new: Derive `title` solely from finalized `meaning`. Give its central topic a brief, natural name. When several actions serve a stated goal, name the goal and leave the actions in `meaning`. The title may use a broader familiar name for the same topic; `meaning` supplies the exact scope and qualifications. Use a broader name when shortening could suggest the wrong person or relationship. Do not change `meaning` to fit the title. If `meaning` is null, `title` must be null.
